GAME SETTINGS

Spanish pronunciation · 20 common verbs per set.
Verb type describes the verb overall. Only ser, ir and ver are irregular in the imperfect.
How to play
Read the English phrase. Click the central circle or press Enter to hear it in Spanish, then shoot the matching conjugation. Type the correct conjugation to unlock the next challenge.

← → / A D: rotate aim
Space: fire · P: pause
Mouse / touch: aim and shoot

Five lives. Four answers. Each new round gets slightly faster.

PASTE / EDIT VERBS

One infinitive per line; known verbs already include meanings. You can paste trabajar | to work or tab-separated Quizlet pairs.
For a new verb, supply the English meaning and six forms for the selected tense (update these when you change tense):
verb | to ... | yo, tú, él, nosotros, vosotros, ellos
